inspection_summary: Inspected all 2,426 lines. The survey develops Voronin universality from finite Euler-product approximation and phase independence, then tracks single, joint, strong, mixed, discrete, character-aspect, hybrid, composite, quantitative, and ergodic forms while identifying their independence inputs, target restrictions, consequences, and open obstructions.

sections_inspected.label: 1. Voronin theorem
sections_inspected.mathematical_role: Defines positive-density uniform approximation, sketches the Euler-product/Kronecker-Weyl proof, and relates function-space density to limit theorems.

sections_inspected.label: 2. Historical stages
sections_inspected.mathematical_role: Organizes the shift from first variants through class extension to mixed, composite, and ergodic directions.

sections_inspected.label: 3. Euler-product generalizations
sections_inspected.mathematical_role: Identifies coefficient-mean obstacles, the positive-density workaround, and prime-geodesic input.

sections_inspected.label: 4. Joint universality
sections_inspected.mathematical_role: Encodes independence by character orthogonality, matrix rank, prime coefficient means, and Selberg orthogonality.

sections_inspected.label: 5. Strong universality
sections_inspected.mathematical_role: Removes target nonvanishing, derives linear zero density, and gives a general-series criterion plus counterexample.

sections_inspected.label: 6. Joint strong universality
sections_inspected.mathematical_role: Compares rank and logarithmic-independence conditions and records functional-relation obstructions.

sections_inspected.label: 7. Multiple zeta-functions
sections_inspected.mathematical_role: Transfers strong universality to multiple sums subject to a lower-depth nonvanishing gate.

sections_inspected.label: 8. Mixed universality
sections_inspected.mathematical_role: Combines Euler-product and non-Euler-product families through joint frequency independence.

sections_inspected.label: 9. Strong recurrence
sections_inspected.mathematical_role: Relates self-approximation to RH and examines generalized shift ratios and corrected gaps.

sections_inspected.label: 10. Weighted universality
sections_inspected.mathematical_role: Replaces uniform time average by an ergodically admissible weight.

sections_inspected.label: 11. Discrete universality
sections_inspected.mathematical_role: Shows how sampling-step arithmetic changes independence conditions and Euler factors.

sections_inspected.label: 12. Character-aspect universality
sections_inspected.mathematical_role: Moves the approximation parameter to characters or discriminants and obtains value/class-number density.

sections_inspected.label: 13. Applications
sections_inspected.mathematical_role: Derives derivative density, functional independence, and counterexamples to proposed bounds.

sections_inspected.label: 14. General universality
sections_inspected.mathematical_role: Places zeta universality in orbit-density and rearrangement theory.

sections_inspected.label: 15. Hybrid universality
sections_inspected.mathematical_role: Couples function approximation with prescribed torus phases to handle algebraic combinations.

sections_inspected.label: 16. Quantitative results
sections_inspected.mathematical_role: Contrasts ineffective rearrangement with convexity, quantitative equidistribution, and limit-rate methods.

sections_inspected.label: 17. Derived functions
sections_inspected.mathematical_role: Studies operator conditions preserving universality and differential alternatives.

sections_inspected.label: 18. Ergodicity
sections_inspected.mathematical_role: Recasts universality as recurrence under ergodic iterates and random walks.
